title: White Label Video, Design & Web for Agencies · Vibescape
desc: White label video editing, motion design, social content, design and web development for agencies. Your brand on the work, our team behind it. Senior team in Lahore.
lead: Take on more clients without hiring. We work behind your brand on editing, motion, design and builds, with your deadlines, your file naming and your quality bar.

points.title: White label
points.text: Your logo, your client, your voice. We never contact your clients unless you ask us to.

points.title: Senior team
points.text: Editors, motion designers, designers and developers who have shipped work for real brands.

points.title: Fast turnaround
points.text: A team that works while you sleep, so briefs sent in the evening can be ready by morning.

points.title: Flexible capacity
points.text: A dedicated pod on retainer, or overflow work project by project.

links.title: Video editing and colour
links.text: Brand films, reels and ad cutdowns, finished by our post studio Vesa.

links.title: Motion and 3D
links.text: Logo animations, product animation and motion graphics.

links.title: Design
links.text: Social content, decks, packaging and brand systems.

links.title: Web development
links.text: Shopify, Webflow and custom builds from your designs.

faq.q: Will our clients know you exist?
faq.a: No. White label means the work is delivered as yours. NDAs are standard.
Through a shared portal where each brief becomes a task with an owner and a due date, so you can track every job.

faq.q: Can we start with a small test?
faq.a: Yes. Most agencies start with one paid test project before moving to a retainer.
Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Figma, Shopify, Webflow and modern web stacks.
